I signed up with Vista on a Tuesday.

Thursday I wrote my first service contract.

No contract to negotiate. No appointment to sit through. No 30-day onboarding call with someone reading me a slide deck.

The EzLinks integration was already talking to my book. I added one line to a conversation I was already having — "want me to protect what's under the hood too?" — and my client said yes before I finished explaining it.

She signed online. Took her under a minute.

She skipped the dealer markup and still got comprehensive coverage, unlimited miles, any ASE shop in the country.

And she thanked ME for it.
